info.title: ControlServer.ClockSkewProxy
info.description: A one-route reverse proxy in front of ControlServer's vehicle-safety projection that moves observedAt by a configurable offset, so an L2 scenario can exercise the onboard's clock-skew tolerance (8005-agv-onboard-hmi#1) on a machine where both ends share one clock. Loopback only.

get.summary: Forward the upstream projection with observedAt shifted by skewMs
get.description: The Authorization header is forwarded verbatim. A non-success upstream response, and a body that is not JSON, are passed through untouched so the onboard's own fail-closed paths still see them. Unknown fields survive the rewrite.

get.summary: Liveness, current skewMs and forward target
Current skewMs plus the forward log (count, last upstream status, last observedAt in and out)

put.summary: Set the offset applied to observedAt

post.summary: Start a new round at revision 1

expectedRevision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check, skipped on a replay.

skewMs.description: Milliseconds added to observedAt. Positive puts the evidence in the onboard's future, which is what a slow onboard clock looks like from the wire; negative is a fast one.
